You have no saved styles of your own yet. Reply with a style name, or upload your video with /edit-video [name].

More commands

/edit-video clean — removes mistakes, filler words and dead air. No style.

/edit-video cutout — removes your background, keeps you on a transparent video.

/edit-video blur — blurs your real background, keeps you sharp.

/edit-video background — puts you on a new background: your own photo, or one drawn for your video (talking-head videos only).

/edit-video save this style as [name] — teaches a style from a video you upload, so you can reuse it.
